tests_proposed.command: bash scripts/setup.sh (fresh .env, repeated setup, then rotated/deleted .env while preserving the named volume)
tests_proposed.reason: Coordinator must verify provisioning, credential reconciliation, and volume preservation with Docker.

assumptions: Compose detects changed DB environment values and recreates the db container while preserving its explicitly named volume.
The official PostgreSQL image permits local socket access for the POSTGRES_USER owner, allowing psql reconciliation without sending an old password.
Compose passes current DB_PASSWORD and POSTGRES_PASSWORD into the db container before the reconciliation script executes.
notes: Setup validates Compose, starts and waits for db, then executes the project-owned reconcile script inside the db container before building or starting app.
The reconciliation script creates claims_app if missing and always ALTERs claims_app and claims_owner passwords with bound psql variables; no database volume is removed or reinitialized.
This fixes recovery after local .env deletion or credential rotation while retaining existing database data. Runtime checks remain NOT_RUN pending coordinator verification.
